answer_1.quote: We train a T5-Base model on HotpotQA ... to generate questions for our conversational chunks. ... We train a BART summarizer on News and dialogue summarization corpora and run QG models on top of the generated summaries.

answer_2.quote: We follow the standard evaluation metrics in the QA community: exact match (EM) and F1 scores... We also report the FZ-R scores, which used the Levenshtein distance...

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation by sampling 200 conversation chunks randomly ... three annotators to label fluency, complexity, and confidence.
answer_4.guideline: Rate fluency of the question, complexity of finding the answer, and confidence of the answer.
